description_en: Extracts text from images in natural reading order and outputs formatted results with support for bounding boxes and content. Output formats include JSON and Markdown
description_zh: 智能文档解析产品，支持提取图片中的文字并按照自然阅读顺序进行格式化输出，同时支持boundingbox和内容的输出，输出格式支持json和markdown
name: DocumentParseOnlineApi

parameters.help_en:
Valid values:

0: JSON with bounding box and content

1: JSON with bounding box only

2: Markdown
parameters.help_zh:
枚举值及含义如下：

0：json带bbox+content

1：json带bbox

2：markdown
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the document image to be parsed. The URL must be publicly accessible
parameters.help_zh: 需要解析的文档图片链接（要求是公网可访问的链接）
parameters.name: image_url
